item.title: Jury deadlocks on murder charge in retrial of man who stabbed grandmother
item.description: BAKERSFIELD, Calif. (KGET) -- A Kern County jury on Friday deadlocked on a charge of second-degree murder in the retrial of a man who stabbed his 70-year-old grandmother. Jurors split 8-4 in the trial of Juan Andres Valdez, with the majority voting not guilty, according to a release from the Kern County Public Defender's Office. [...]
